skorost-otveta: Scene: a client (adult, casual clothes, seen from behind/side) holds a smartphone showing a chat with one sent message bubble; beside them floats a large soft clock or hourglass. In the background, slightly blurred, a second smartphone already shows a reply bubble with a lime dot arriving first. The idea: the speed of the first reply decides who gets the client.
odno-okno: Scene: several separate small abstract chat windows (different shapes, no logos) floating from left side flow along soft lines into one large calm monitor screen on a tidy desk that shows a single neat list of message rows, a few with lime dots. The idea: all client messages from different messengers gathered in one window.
chat-bot-ili-assistent: Scene: split composition on a desk. Left: a simple matte toy-like robot with a rigid flowchart of arrows behind it. Right: a manager's hand holding a smartphone with a draft message bubble and a single lime approve button being pressed by the thumb. The idea: choosing between a scripted chat bot and an assistant that prepares a reply for the manager to approve.
zapisi-zvonkov: Scene: a desk phone handset and a pair of headphones next to soft abstract audio waveforms floating in the air, the waveforms turn into neat stacked note cards / rule cards with abstract grey lines, one card marked with a lime highlight. The idea: call recordings are analysed and turned into rules for the assistant.
novyj-ili-postoyannyj: Scene: two chat message bubbles arriving on a smartphone screen lying on a desk; next to one bubble floats a small abstract client card with a lime star badge (regular client), next to the other a plain empty card with a small plus sign (new client). A manager's hand reaches toward the phone. The idea: recognising from the first message whether it is a new or a returning client.
chto-sprosit: Scene: a clipboard with a checklist (abstract grey lines and check boxes, a few ticked with lime ticks) on a desk next to a smartphone showing a chat with a question bubble, a pen and a cup of coffee. The idea: a checklist of what to ask a client at the first contact.
poteryannye-zayavki: Scene: a funnel made of matte clay on a desk; many small message bubbles enter at the top, fewer come out at the bottom into a small box; some bubbles leak out through gaps on the side and fall, a calculator and a notepad with an abstract bar chart lie next to it, one bar highlighted lime. The idea: counting how many requests are lost between the request and the sale.
oshibki-vnedreniya: Scene: a smartphone on a desk with a draft reply bubble that is stopped by a manager's raised hand / a soft barrier; around the bubble float small warning signs: a price tag crossed out, an exclamation mark, a padlock, one highlighted lime. The idea: preventing an AI assistant from naming wrong prices, making promises or touching forbidden topics - the manager approves before sending.
